header.title: ScaleTransition
header.description: Pop-in / pop-out scale (+ opacity) for modals, tooltips, and popovers. Toggle `isIn`; the node stays mounted until the exit transform ends. Set `preserveSpace` to keep the layout box when out. Use `origin` to anchor the scale.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine props, toggle scale in/out, and watch the generated code. Enter uses `enter` timing; exit uses `exit`.
playground.label: Scale panel

base.title: Base
base.description: With defaults (`scale={0.92}`, `origin="center"`, `duration={300}`) the panel scales and fades. After exit it unmounts unless `preserveSpace` / `keepMounted`.

fromTop.title: Origin top
fromTop.description: Scales from the top edge — typical for a dropdown under a trigger. Starts hidden; press Scale in to replay.

modalPop.title: Modal pop
modalPop.description: Stronger pop (`scale: 0.88`) with `emphasized` enter easing — suited to dialogs.

tooltip.title: Tooltip anchor
tooltip.description: Subtle scale from the bottom (`origin="bottom"`, `scale: 0.96`) — typical when a tooltip sits above its anchor.

timing.title: Enter / exit timing
timing.description: `duration`, `delay`, and `easing` accept `{ enter, exit }`. Enter is slower with delay; exit is snappy.

preserveSpace.title: preserveSpace
preserveSpace.description: With `preserveSpace`, the node stays mounted when out — the layout box is reserved and siblings below do not jump.

texts.label: Reserved panel
texts.sibling: Sibling content — stays put while the panel scales out.

keepMounted.title: keepMounted
keepMounted.description: With `keepMounted`, exit hides the host with `display: none` instead of unmounting. Re-enter restores the same DOM node.

initial.title: initial false
initial.description: `initial={false}` skips motion on the first mount (snaps in). Later toggles still scale. Use Remount to see the skip again.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: With `isDisabled` (or `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`) the host snaps to the target state with no interpolation.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, scale classes merge onto the single child (no extra wrapper).

texts.title: Dialog
texts.body: Slotted host — the scale runs on the Card.

utilities.title: Utility classes
utilities.description: Pass `utilities.css` helpers via `classNames.root`. This demo applies `gemst-relative` and `gemst-overflow-hidden`.

header.title: ScaleTransition API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `ScaleTransition`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for origin, modal pop, tooltip, and preserveSpace.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/scale-transition` with its `scale-transition.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. In that case classes and styles merge with the child's, and if both define the same handler, the child's runs first. The component handles onTransitionEnd internally (to detect the end of transform) and then calls yours.

items.presence: This is a presence transition: the control that toggles isIn should reflect state. Do not convey information with the scale alone.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the host snaps to the final state. The preference is read each render; it is not live-listened.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion on the root. Use only when motion is essential.
items.preserveSpace: With preserveSpace the box stays reserved; content hides with opacity and scale. Siblings should not jump.
items.keepMounted: With keepMounted the node stays in the DOM with display: none after exit. It should not receive focus or be announced while hidden.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a child with the right semantics (Card, dialog, div): that element is the scale host.

items.root: Root (`div`, or the child with `asChild`). `inline-flex`; transitions `opacity` and `transform`.
items.prep: Enter priming: no transition so the resting state cannot flash.
items.keepMountedHidden: Host hidden after exit with `keepMounted` (`display: none`).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline each render (`0ms` when `isDisabled`, reduced motion, or keep-mounted hidden).

items.duration: Duration of the current phase. Default `300ms`.
items.delay: Delay of the current phase. Default `0ms`.
items.easing: Easing of the current phase. Default `standard`.
items.from: Scale factor when out / at enter start. Default `0.92`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables used as CSS defaults.

items.easingStandard: Default for `--gemst-scale-easing`. The component writes the resolved curve inline — use `easing` to change it.

content.title: Content
content.description: What scales and where it mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Presence, factor, anchor, and how it stays mounted.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: In milliseconds. `enter` applies on scale in and `exit` on scale out.

items.children: Content that scales in and out.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child (no extra wrapper).
items.isIn: `true` scales in and stays mounted; `false` scales out and unmounts after the transition (unless `preserveSpace` / `keepMounted`).
items.scale: Factor when out / at enter start (`1` = full size). Default `0.92`.
items.preserveSpace: On exit, keeps the node mounted and reserves the layout box. Ignored when `unmountOnExit`.
items.keepMounted: After exit, hides the host with `display: none` instead of unmounting. Ignored when `unmountOnExit`.
items.unmountOnExit: Unmounts immediately on exit (skips the exit scale).
items.initial: `false` skips motion on the first mount. Later toggles still animate. Default `true`.
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is scale in and `exit` is scale out.
items.delay: Wait before starting. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.easing: Token (`standard`, `enter`, `exit`, `emphasized`, `linear`), timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default `standard`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the target state with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onScale: Fires when the scale is active (`isIn` true).
items.outScale: Fires on exit (`isIn` false), disable, or unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with `--gemst-scale-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
